definition_zh: 加强的；集中的；密集的；精耕细作的
definition_en: involving a lot of effort, work, or attention in a short period, or concentrated on one area
core_image: 一小块地里插满了苗，水和肥料都浇到同几垄上
scene: 教室里只有六个人，两周内每天八节课，教材翻到了最后几页。The hospital opened a new intensive care unit on the top floor.
sceneCN: 这里 intensive 是「加强的、密集的」（第 1 个义项：短期投入大量精力），句意医院在顶层新开了重症监护病房，即集中照护的地方。画面里的物件：教材、病区指示牌、护理记录。

pos.zh: 形容词：加强的；集中的；密集的；精耕细作的

derivatives.zh: 由同一词干构成，义为「强度」
由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「密集地」
由同一词干加 -ify 构成，义为「加强」
由同一词干构成，义为「强烈的」

senses.title: Concentrated in time
senses.definition: involving much effort and attention in a short period
senses.definitionCN: 在短期内投入大量精力与注意力
senses.example: The students took an intensive course in summer.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们在夏天上了一个强化课程。
senses.why: The suffix -ive means "tending to", so intensive describes effort gathered onto one point.
senses.whyCN: -ive 意为「倾向于」，因此 intensive 形容力量聚于一点。

senses.title: Of land and farming
senses.definition: using a lot of labour, water, and fertilizer on a small area of land
senses.definitionCN: 在小面积土地上投入大量人工、水与肥料
senses.example: Intensive farming feeds more people from fewer fields.
senses.exampleCN: 集约农业用更少的田地养活更多的人。
senses.why: Agriculture borrowed the idea of effort concentrated on one plot.
senses.whyCN: 农业借用了「精力集中于一小块地」这一想法。

senses.title: Of medical care
senses.definition: giving constant close attention to a seriously ill patient
senses.definitionCN: 对危重病人给予持续的密切照护
senses.example: She spent a week in intensive care after the accident.
senses.exampleCN: 事故后她在重症监护病房住了一周。
senses.why: Hospitals needed a word for care with no moment left unattended.
senses.whyCN: 医院需要一个词来形容每一刻都不放空的照护。

senses.title: Grammar: adding force
senses.definition: added to a word to strengthen it, as very does
senses.definitionCN: 加在词上以加强语气，如 very 的作用
senses.example: The adverb is used here as an intensive word.
senses.exampleCN: 这里这个副词起了强调作用。
senses.why: Grammarians applied the same metaphor to words that press harder.
senses.whyCN: 语法学家把同一比喻用到了「加力」的词上。

intro.en: Intensive adds the Latin ending -ivus "tending to" to the participle of intendere.
intro.cn: intensive 在 intendere 的分词上加拉丁词尾 -ivus「倾向于」。

items.en: Tendere "to stretch" with in- gives intendere, to strain towards something.
items.cn: tendere「伸展」加 in- 构成 intendere「向某物绷紧」。

items.en: Intensus was the past participle, used of a drawn bow or attentive mind.
items.cn: intensus 是过去分词，用于拉开的弓或专注的心。

items.en: The ending -ivus marked a tendency or direction of action.
items.cn: 词尾 -ivus 标出动作的倾向或方向。

items.en: English formed intensive in the seventeenth century for effort gathered in one place.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪造出 intensive，指力量集于一处。

items.en: Farming, medicine, and language teaching each adopted it in turn.
items.cn: 农业、医学与语言教学先后各自采用了它。

note.en: The look-alike group differs from intense only by the ending; the near-meaning group holds words for concentrated effort.
note.cn: 形近组与 intense 只差词尾；近义组收表示集中投入的词。

entries.definition: Very strong in degree, of heat or feeling.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，指程度强烈，多用于热或感受。

entries.definition: The measured strength of something.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为可测量的强度。

entries.definition: Covering a wide area rather than a deep point.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「广泛的」，铺开而非集中。

entries.definition: Complete in every part, with nothing skipped.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「彻底的」，没有遗漏。

entries.definition: Gathered into one place or brought to full strength.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「集中的」，汇于一处或加大浓度。

entries.definition: Strict and demanding in standards.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「严格的」，要求高。

normalIntro.en: The hooks lean on the difference between intensive and intense and on real course names.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子利用 intensive 与 intense 的差别，也借助真实的课程名称。

normal.en: Intensive work is piled into days; intense work merely feels extreme.
normal.cn: intensive 是几天里塞满活儿，intense 只是感觉极端。

normal.en: An intensive course trades length for density.
normal.cn: 强化课程用短时间换高密度。

normal.en: Intensive care watches every breath.
normal.cn: 重症监护盯着每一次呼吸。

normal.en: Intensive farming squeezes more from one field.
normal.cn: 集约农业从一块地里挤出更多产出。

normal.en: Intensive reading takes ten pages slowly.
normal.cn: 精读就是很慢地读十页。

abstract.en: Intensive means one spot held under a burning glass.
abstract.cn: 密集就是以燃烧的透镜照住一处。

abstract.en: Not wider, only deeper: that is the intensive way.
abstract.cn: 不求更宽，只求更深，这就是密集的路子。

abstract.en: Some learning must be pressed, like coffee.
abstract.cn: 有些学习必须像咖啡一样被压实。

examples.en: He signed up for a four-week intensive German course.
examples.cn: 他报了一个四周的德语强化课程。

examples.en: Intensive training left the team strong but tired.
examples.cn: 密集训练让队伍变强，也很疲惫。

examples.en: The farmer turned his small plot into intensive rice fields.
examples.cn: 这位农民把小地块改成了精耕稻田。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因太细五」——学习细到五个点都抠，就是强化

sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：短期集中投入、农业经营、医疗照护，以及语法上的强调。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small plot crowded with seedlings and watched every day.
core.cn: 核心意象：一小块地里插满苗，天天有人看顾。

branches.cn: 暑期课程这条线：课时塞进几周里。

branches.en: THE SMALL FIELD: land is worked hard, not widely.
branches.cn: 小田块这条线：地是精耕的，不是铺开的。

branches.en: THE WARD: attention never lets go of the patient.
branches.cn: 病房这条线：注意力一刻不离病人。

branches.cn: 强调词这条线：一个小小的 very 把意思压得更重。

definition_zh: 意图；目的；adj. 专注的；坚决的
definition_en: a purpose or aim, or being firmly fixed on doing something
core_image: 一双眼睛盯住门口的动静，肩膀一动不动
scene: 猫伏在门口，耳朵贴着门缝，一动不动地等那阵脚步声。Her intent was never to embarrass him, only to warn him.
sceneCN: 这里 intent 是「意图」（第 1 个义项：心里想达到的目的），句意她的意图从不是让他难堪，只是提醒他。画面里的物件：门缝、猫的耳朵、静止的肩膀。

pos.zh: 名词：意图；目的
形容词：专注的；坚决的

senses.title: Purpose behind an act
senses.definition: the purpose or aim that lies behind what someone does
senses.definitionCN: 某人行为背后的目的或目标
senses.example: The court asked whether there was intent to defraud.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭追问是否有欺诈的意图。
senses.why: Latin intentus, the participle of intendere, hardened into a noun for a fixed aim.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语分词 intentus 硬化为表示「既定目标」的名词。

senses.title: Fixed attention
senses.definition: giving all your attention to something, often with the body still
senses.definitionCN: 把全部注意力放在某物上，身体往往一动不动
senses.example: The children were intent on the magician's hands.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们紧盯着魔术师的手。
senses.why: The adjective keeps the physical image of a stretched, unmoving posture.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词保留了「绷紧、不动」的身体形象。

senses.title: Firmly determined
senses.definition: strongly determined to do something and unlikely to be turned aside
senses.definitionCN: 坚决要做某事，不易被劝开
senses.example: He was intent on finishing the climb before dark.
senses.exampleCN: 他一心要在天黑前登顶。
senses.why: Determination is an aim that will not let the mind relax.
senses.whyCN: 决心是那个不让心思松下来的目标。

intro.en: Intent is the Latin participle of intendere used as a noun and an adjective in English.
intro.cn: intent 是拉丁语 intendere 的分词，在英语中兼作名词与形容词。

items.en: Tendere "to stretch" with in- "towards" gives intendere, to aim the mind.
items.cn: tendere「伸展」与 in-「朝向」构成 intendere「把心瞄向某处」。

items.en: The participle intensus described a mind or a bow held taut.
items.cn: 分词 intensus 形容绷紧的心或弓。

items.en: Legal Latin used intentio for the aim that gives an act its character.
items.cn: 法律拉丁语用 intentio 指赋予行为性质的那个目的。

items.en: French entent brought both the noun and the adjective into English.
items.cn: 法语 entent 把名词与形容词一起带入英语。

items.en: Modern law keeps intent as a technical word; everyday speech uses it for absorbed attention.
items.cn: 现代法律保留 intent 为术语，日常言语则用它表示全神贯注。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the aiming root; the near-meaning group holds other words for purpose.
note.cn: 形近组共享「瞄准」词根；近义组收其他表示目的的词语。

entries.definition: The verb of planning to do something.

entries.definition: A plan, often less fixed or formal than intent.

entries.definition: Satisfied, or what something holds.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「满足的」，名词义为「内容」。

entries.definition: The reason for which something is done.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「目的」，做事的理由。

entries.definition: The target one tries to reach.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「目标」，想达到的那一点。

entries.definition: Firmness of will, the quality rather than the goal.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「决心」，指品质而非目标。

normalIntro.en: The hooks take the taut bow of intendere and the legal phrase with intent.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子取自 intendere 那张绷紧的弓，以及法律短语 with intent。

normal.en: Intent is an aim pulled tight and held.

normal.en: The police asked about intent, not about accident.

normal.en: Be intent on the road, not on the phone.

normal.en: For all intents and purposes, the deal is done.

normal.en: An intent look is quiet, not busy.
normal.cn: 专注的神情是静的，不是忙的。

abstract.en: Intent is the arrow's straight line before release.
abstract.cn: 意图是离弦前那支箭的直线。

abstract.en: We cannot see intent, only its shadow in behaviour.
abstract.cn: 我们看不见意图，只能看见它在行为里的影子。

abstract.en: A fixed eye makes a still body.
abstract.cn: 目光一固定，身体就静止。

examples.en: His intent was to protect the family business.
examples.cn: 他的意图是保住家族生意。

examples.en: The boy sat intent on his drawing for an hour.
examples.cn: 男孩专心画画，坐了一小时。

examples.en: She was intent on reaching the summit by noon.
examples.cn: 她一心想在中午前登顶。

branches.en: THE COURTROOM: the purpose behind an act is examined.
branches.cn: 法庭这条线：审的是行为背后的目的。

branches.en: THE MAGICIAN'S HANDS: attention is all given.
branches.cn: 魔术师的手这条线：注意力全部交出。

branches.en: THE CLIMB: the aim will not let the will relax.
branches.cn: 登山这条线：目标不让意志松手。

branches.en: THE LINK: purpose and will both keep one point fixed.
branches.cn: 连接线：目的与意志都把一点固定住。

branches.en: THE LINK: absorbed attention looks like determination.
branches.cn: 连接线：全神贯注看起来就像决心。

definition_zh: 意图；意向；打算
definition_en: a plan or aim that you have in mind, especially before doing something
core_image: 出门前在便签上写下一行小计划，贴在门边
scene: 桌角压着一张便签，上面写着明早要去的地方，还有要带的东西。He had no intention of selling the boat, whatever the price.
sceneCN: 这里 intention 是「打算、意向」（第 1 个义项：心里的计划），句意无论价钱多少，他都无意卖掉那条船。画面里的物件：便签、压纸的茶杯、笔。

pos.zh: 名词：意图；意向；打算

senses.title: A plan in mind
senses.definition: something you plan or mean to do, often before any action is taken
senses.definitionCN: 你计划或打算要做的事，常在行动之前就在心里
senses.example: Her intention was to study law, not medicine.
senses.exampleCN: 她的打算是学法律，不是学医。
senses.why: Latin intentio names the stretching of the mind towards a target.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 intentio 指心灵朝目标伸展的动作。

senses.title: The reason behind an act
senses.definition: the purpose that explains why something was done
senses.definitionCN: 解释某事为何被做的那个目的
senses.example: The letter was written with the best of intentions.
senses.exampleCN: 这封信是怀着一片好意写的。
senses.why: Actions are read through intentions: the same deed can be kind or cruel.
senses.whyCN: 行为要透过用意来读：同一个举动可以是善意，也可以是残忍。

senses.title: Meaning in words
senses.definition: the meaning a speaker or writer wants words to carry
senses.definitionCN: 说话或写作的人希望词语承载的意义
senses.example: The intention of the rule is to keep the path clear.
senses.exampleCN: 这条规则的用意是让小路保持通畅。
senses.why: Law and criticism speak of the intention of a text when they argue about meaning.
senses.whyCN: 法律与批评在争论意义时，会谈文本的「意图」。

intro.en: Intention is the Latin noun intentio, "a stretching towards", from intendere.
intro.cn: intention 是拉丁语名词 intentio「朝……伸展」，来自 intendere。

items.en: In- "towards" with tendere "to stretch" gives intendere.
items.cn: in-「朝向」与 tendere「伸展」构成 intendere。

items.en: Intentio named both the physical tension and the aim of the mind.
items.cn: intentio 兼指物理的张力与心灵的瞄准。

items.en: Scholastic writers used intentio for the direction of the will and of meaning.
items.cn: 经院作家用 intentio 指意志的方向与意义所指。

items.en: French entencion brought the word into English writing in the Middle Ages.

note.en: The look-alike group shares the aiming root; the near-meaning group holds words for plans and purposes.

entries.definition: Purpose, often sharper and more legal than intention.

entries.definition: The reason a thing exists or is done.

entries.definition: The single point one hopes to hit.

normalIntro.en: The hooks connect the note on the desk with the phrases surrounding intention.

branches.cn: 规则这条线：字句之外还带着用意。

branches.en: THE LINK: plan and reason are the same aim seen before and after.
branches.cn: 连接线：打算与用意是同一目标的前后两面。

branches.en: THE LINK: acts and texts are both read for intent.
branches.cn: 连接线：行为与文本都要被读出意图。

intro.en: Intention = in- "towards" + tent- "stretch" + -ion "the act of".
intro.cn: intention = in-「朝向」+ tent-「伸展」+ -ion「……的行为」。

latinIntro.en: Latin intendere and intentio are attested; the suffix layers are productive.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 intendere 与 intentio 有记载，各词尾层仍能产。

items.example: It sets the direction of the aim.
The verb is the family trunk.
It turns the verb into a plan.
A shorter word for the same aim.

definition_zh: 相互作用；互相影响；互动
definition_en: to act on each other, or to talk and do things together with other people
core_image: 两个人对着同一个屏幕，你按一下，他回应一句
scene: 小区广场上几个孩子轮流推着同一个球，谁推出去谁就笑着跑开。Some medicines interact badly with coffee.
sceneCN: 这里 interact 是「相互作用、互相配合」（第 1 个义项：彼此产生影响），句意有些药与咖啡同用会产生不良反应。画面里的物件：传着的球、笑声、药盒与咖啡杯。

pos.zh: 动词：相互作用；互相影响；互动

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ion 构成，义为「相互作用；互动」
由本词加 -ive 构成，义为「互动的」
由 interactive 加 -ly 构成，义为「互动地」
由本词去前缀构成，义为「反应」

senses.title: Things acting on each other
senses.definition: to have an effect on each other, as substances, forces, or systems do
senses.definitionCN: 像物质、力或系统那样彼此产生影响
senses.example: The two chemicals interact only when heated.
senses.exampleCN: 这两种化学品只在加热时才相互作用。
senses.why: Inter- means between, agere means to do; together they describe mutual action.
senses.whyCN: inter- 意为「在之间」，agere 意为「做」，合起来即相互的动作。

senses.title: People dealing with people
senses.definition: to talk, work, or play with other people
senses.definitionCN: 与他人交谈、共事或一起玩
senses.example: The children learn to interact before they learn to read.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们先学会相处，再学会阅读。
senses.why: Social life is modelled as actions exchanged between persons.
senses.whyCN: 社交生活被看作人与人之间交换的动作。

senses.title: Users and machines
senses.definition: to use a device or program, giving it instructions and receiving responses
senses.definitionCN: 使用装置或程序，给出指令并收到回应
senses.example: Visitors can interact with the map by touching any district.
senses.exampleCN: 访客可以触碰任一区域来与地图互动。
senses.why: Computing borrowed the word for the back-and-forth between people and machines.
senses.whyCN: 计算机领域借这个词形容人与机器之间的往来。

intro.en: Interact joins Latin inter- "between" to agere "to do", a verb English borrowed from react.
intro.cn: interact 把拉丁语 inter-「在……之间」接到 agere「做」上，而英语是借 react 而造出它的。

items.en: Agere means to drive, do, or act, and yields actus and actio.
items.cn: agere 意为驱动、做、行动，生出 actus 与 actio。

items.en: Inter as a preposition meant between, among, or mutually.
items.cn: inter 作介词意为「在……之间、互相」。

items.en: React appeared first; interact was coined in the early nineteenth century on its pattern.
items.cn: 先有 react，interact 在十九世纪初按它的样子造出。

items.en: Scientists used it for forces and substances acting mutually.
items.cn: 科学家用它指力与物质的相互作用。

items.en: Social science and computing made it the ordinary word for people and screens.
items.cn: 社会科学与计算机让它成为形容人与屏幕的日常词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the agere root of doing; the near-meaning group holds other words for mutual contact.
note.cn: 形近组共享「做」这一词根 agere；近义组收表示相互接触的词。

entries.definition: To act back when something happens to you.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「反应」，对发生的事情作出回应。

entries.definition: A business deal, an acting across between two parties.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「交易」，双方之间完成的一次业务。

entries.definition: To do something, or a deed.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「行动」，名词义为「行为」。

entries.definition: To pass information or feeling to another.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「沟通」，传递信息或感受。

entries.definition: To work with others towards one aim.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「合作」，为同一目标共同努力。

entries.definition: To mix freely in a crowd.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「交际」，在人群中自由往来。

normalIntro.en: The hooks split the word into inter- and act and follow where it is actually used.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把词拆成 inter- 与 act，并沿着它实际使用的场合走。

normal.en: Inter plus act: doing between, back and forth.
normal.cn: inter 加 act：在双方之间来回地做。

normal.en: Two medicines may interact; two friends certainly will.
normal.cn: 两种药会相互作用；两个朋友更是一定会。

normal.en: Children interact with toys before they speak perfectly.
normal.cn: 孩子说话还不流利时就会与玩具互动。

normal.en: Users interact with the map by tapping.
normal.cn: 用户靠轻触与地图互动。

normal.en: React is to act back; interact is to act together.
normal.cn: react 是回身反应，interact 是彼此一起动。

abstract.en: Nothing stands alone: everything interacts.
abstract.cn: 没有东西独自立着，万物都在相互作用。

abstract.en: Characters in a story are known by how they interact.
abstract.cn: 故事里的人物靠彼此往来而被认出来。

abstract.en: The word marks the space between two doings.
abstract.cn: 这个词标出两件事之间的那段空间。

examples.en: These drugs interact with each other and must not be mixed.
examples.cn: 这些药会相互作用，不能混用。

examples.en: Pupils interact with visiting speakers in small groups.
examples.cn: 学生们以小组形式与来访的讲者互动。

examples.en: The child had hardly interacted with anyone all term.
examples.cn: 这孩子整个学期几乎没和任何人来往。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特爱克」——网络特长爱互相切磋，就是互动

root: 拉丁语 inter-「在……之间」+ agere「做、驱动」→ 英语先有 react，再按此模式造出 interact。同族：interaction、react、act。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: mutual action of things, social dealings, and using a device.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：事物的相互作用、人际往来，以及使用装置。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two people pushing one ball back and forth.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个人来回推同一个球。

branches.en: THE TWO CHEMICALS: heat makes them act on each other.
branches.cn: 两种化学品这条线：加热使它们相互起作用。

branches.en: THE PLAYGROUND: play is an exchange of actions.
branches.cn: 操场这条线：游戏就是动作的交换。

branches.en: THE TOUCH SCREEN: a tap brings a reply.
branches.cn: 触屏这条线：一触得到回应。

branches.en: THE LINK: mutual action applies to bodies and to people.
branches.cn: 连接线：相互动作既用于物体也用于人。

branches.en: THE LINK: machines are treated as social partners.
branches.cn: 连接线：机器被当作社交对象。

intro.en: Interact = inter- "between" + act, from Latin agere "to do".
intro.cn: interact = inter-「在……之间」+ act（来自拉丁语 agere「做」）。

latinIntro.en: Latin inter and agere are both recorded; the English compound is modern.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 inter 与 agere 均有记载，英语的合成词则是近代产物。

items.example: From agere, the root of many words.
items.exampleCN: 来自 agere，许多词共同的根。

items.example: The -ent of agere is visible here.
items.exampleCN: agere 的 -ent 在这里可见。

items.example: A plural of the same Latin stem.
items.exampleCN: 同一拉丁词干的复数形式。

definition_zh: 相互作用；交互作用；互动
definition_en: the activity of two or more things or people acting on each other
core_image: 两端各有一只手来回拉同一根绳子，绳子中间打了几个结
scene: 课堂上老师抛出问题，学生接一句，老师再回一句，话在两边来回飞。Daily interaction with neighbours keeps a street safe.
sceneCN: 这里 interaction 是「互动、相互作用」（第 1 个义项：彼此往来的过程），句意与邻居的日常往来让街道更安全。画面里的物件：课桌、举起的手、街角的门阶。

pos.zh: 名词：相互作用；交互作用；互动

derivatives.zh: 由本词去掉 -ion 构成，义为「互动；互相作用」
由本词换后缀构成，义为「互动的」
由 interactive 加 -ly 构成，义为「互动地」
由本词加 -al 构成，义为「与互动有关的」

senses.title: People acting on people
senses.definition: the way people behave towards and respond to one another
senses.definitionCN: 人们彼此相处并相互回应的方式
senses.example: Short interactions at the shop door can make a lonely day lighter.
senses.exampleCN: 店门口几句短短的往来，能让孤单的一天变轻松。
senses.why: It is the noun of action of interact, from Latin inter plus agere.
senses.whyCN: 它是 interact 的行为名词，来自拉丁语 inter 加 agere。

senses.title: Things affecting each other
senses.definition: the combined effect of two or more forces, substances, or systems on each other
senses.definitionCN: 两种或多种力、物质或系统彼此的合成影响
senses.example: The interaction between wind and current shaped the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 风与海流的相互作用塑造了海岸。
senses.why: Science speaks of interactions where a single cause will not explain a result.
senses.whyCN: 在单一原因解释不了结果时，科学就谈相互作用。

senses.title: In scientific research
senses.definition: a measurable effect in which one factor changes how another factor works
senses.definitionCN: 一种可测量的效应：一个因素改变了另一个因素的作用方式
senses.example: The study found an interaction between diet and sleep.
senses.exampleCN: 研究发现饮食与睡眠之间存在交互效应。
senses.why: Statistics needed a word for two things acting together rather than separately.
senses.whyCN: 统计学需要一个词指两个因素一起起作用而不是各自起作用。

senses.title: With machines
senses.definition: the exchange between a user and a device or program
senses.definitionCN: 使用者与装置或程序之间的交换
senses.example: Good design makes interaction with the machine feel natural.
senses.exampleCN: 好的设计让与机器的往来显得自然。
senses.why: Software designers borrowed the social word to describe tapping and typing.
senses.whyCN: 软件设计者借用了这个社交词来描述点按与打字。

intro.en: Interaction combines inter- "between", agere "to do", and the noun ending -ion.
intro.cn: interaction 由 inter-「之间」、agere「做」与名词词尾 -ion 组成。

items.en: Agere "to do, drive" supplied actus and actio.
items.cn: agere「做、驱动」提供了 actus 与 actio。

items.en: Inter as a prefix marked what happens between two parties.
items.cn: inter 作前缀标出发生在两方之间的事。

items.en: Interaction was formed in the eighteenth century for mutual influence.
items.cn: interaction 在十八世纪成形，指相互影响。

items.en: Social science adopted it for the study of persons and groups.
items.cn: 社会科学采用它来研究个人与群体。

items.en: Computing added human-computer interaction, now a field of its own.
items.cn: 计算机领域添上了「人机交互」，如今已是独立学科。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the agere root; the near-meaning group holds other words for exchanges.
note.cn: 形近组共享 agere 词根；近义组收其他表示交流的词。

entries.definition: The verb of acting mutually.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「互动」。

entries.definition: A response to something that happened.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「反应」，对已发生之事的回应。

entries.definition: Doing something, without the mutual element.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「行动」，不含相互之意。

entries.definition: The passing of information or feeling.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「交流」，传达信息或感受。

entries.definition: The mere fact of touching or meeting.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「接触」，只指碰上或会面。

entries.definition: A giving and taking in return.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「交换」，给出去并收回。

normalIntro.en: The hooks hold on to the image of words flying back and forth across a room.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子抓住「话在房间里来回飞」这一画面。

normal.en: Inter- between, act do, -ion the process: doing between.
normal.cn: inter- 在之间，act 做，-ion 过程：在双方之间来回做。

normal.en: Social interaction at the door can save a whole day.
normal.cn: 门口几句交往能救回一整天的心情。

normal.en: Wind and water interaction built the harbour.
normal.cn: 风与水的相互作用造出了这个港口。

normal.en: Human-computer interaction is now taught as its own subject.
normal.cn: 人机交互如今已作为独立学科讲授。

normal.en: Fewer screens means more face-to-face interaction.
normal.cn: 少盯屏幕就多一些面对面往来。

abstract.en: Everything interesting happens between things.
abstract.cn: 一切有趣的事都发生在事物之间。

abstract.en: A conversation is a rope pulled from both ends.
abstract.cn: 一段对话是一根两端都在拉的绳。

abstract.en: Isolation is the absence of a single interaction.
abstract.cn: 孤立就是连一次往来都没有。

examples.en: Regular interaction with teachers helps shy children speak up.
examples.cn: 常与老师往来能让害羞的孩子开口。

examples.en: The interaction of light and shadow gives the painting its depth.
examples.cn: 光与影的相互作用赋予这幅画深度。

examples.en: The app was praised for smooth interaction between pages.
examples.cn: 这款应用因页面之间流畅的交互而受到称赞。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特爱克神」——网上互相支持得很神，就是互动

root: 拉丁语 inter-「在……之间」+ agere「做、驱动」+ -ion → 英语 interaction。同族：interact、interactive、react、action。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: people with people, things with things, statistical effects, and users with machines.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：人与人的往来、物与物的影响、统计上的交互效应，以及人与机器的往来。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a rope pulled from both ends, knotted in the middle.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根两端都在拉的绳，中间打了结。

branches.en: THE SHOP DOOR: small exchanges between neighbours.
branches.cn: 店门这条线：邻里之间的小小往来。

branches.en: THE COAST: wind and water make one shape together.
branches.cn: 海岸这条线：风与水共同造出一个形状。

branches.en: THE STUDY: one factor changes another's effect.
branches.cn: 研究这条线：一个因素改变另一因素的作用。

branches.en: THE SCREEN: a tap and a reply count as a social act.
branches.cn: 屏幕这条线：一点一回应被当作社交动作。

branches.en: THE LINK: machines join human social habits.
branches.cn: 连接线：机器进入了人的社交习惯。

intro.en: Interaction = inter- "between" + act- "do" + -ion.
intro.cn: interaction = inter-「在……之间」+ act-「做」+ -ion。

latinIntro.en: Latin inter and agere are attested; the modern noun is English-built.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 inter 与 agere 有记载，这个近代名词是英语自行构成。

items.example: It forms reaction, the one-way cousin.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 reaction，只回不互的表亲。

items.example: It allows multi-interaction in new writing.
items.exampleCN: 它使新写作里能说多方互动。
